about_the_game:
1) This is a flight shooting game with simple operation, exciting shooting and intense combat;

2) This trial version offers the first 4 levels, telling the story of the war between "Fat Bird" and "us" from a parallel world, with an experience time of about 3 hours;

3) In four 3D scenes with different terrains, engage in battles with enemies through powerful firepower for tasks such as defense, attack, escort, and fire support;

4) The enemies all adopt a random entry method, making every clearance a challenge;

5) Various combat vehicles, aircraft, fire towers, and bases make the gameplay of the game interesting and rich;

6) Players have three different types of weapons, and the trial version also provides two types of firepower support, providing players with powerful firepower output.

7) The powerful firepower output and the exhilarating firepower suppression brought by firepower support allow you to fully enjoy the fun of combat.
